latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Work Buddy: Calm, proactive workday companionship skill.

- Provides natural, brief check-ins and concise updates without being noisy or intrusive.
- Supports user rhythm with context-aware nudges, energy support, and soft reminders.
- Prioritizes useful, short, and easy-to-ignore messages that fit work patterns.
- Avoids repetitive, clingy, or filler communication; respects user attention and boundaries.
- Designed for users seeking low-pressure, supportive presence during the workday.
